item.title: Pentagon to cut ties with Columbia, Yale, Brown and others Hegseth accuses of ‘wokeness’
item.description: Hegseth said the universities have become “breeding grounds of toxic indoctrination” that undermine military values.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 28, 2026
item.description: Soft words can mend small rifts around us. With educated Mercury conjoining lovely Venus at 12:35 am EST, messages are best sent with affection -- even if we've been wronged by the recipient. We can mend a mix-up by offering a kind note, because this loving convergence supports simple requests and sincere apologies. item.title: Federal judge extends order protecting refugees in Minnesota from being arrested and deported
item.description: The order applies only in Minnesota.

item.title: Injured mother manatee and calf are rescued in Florida and taken to SeaWorld
item.description: At least six manatees were rescued because of cold stress, watercraft injuries and malnutrition.

item.title: Treasury Department terminates union contracts for IRS and Bureau of the Fiscal Service workers
item.description: Workers at the Bureau of the Fiscal Service are also affected.

item.title: Los Angeles school superintendent placed on paid leave amid federal probe
item.description: Alberto Carvalho, who became superintendent in 2022, previously led the public schools in Miami.

item.title: Sleepy owl found resting among items on a New York antique store shelf
item.description: Customers at The Market Place had spotted “something extremely lifelike” on one of the shelves.

item.title: With only 3 women left, an Amazon tribe faced extinction. An unexpected birth now brings hope
item.description: Three women lived for years as the last members of the Akuntsu people.

item.title: Questionable goal key as Sabres send Panthers to hobbling home loss
item.description: Florida, which has lost six of its past eight, is eight points behind Boston for the second wild-card spot in the Eastern Conference with only 23 games left.

item.title: St. Thomas Aquinas, led by Thomases, rallies past Nova in girls 6A regional final
item.description: St. Thomas Aquinas senior guard Ronneisha Thomas drained a tie-breaking 3-pointer with 13.1 seconds remaining.
